observations: Photo 0: A Nikon-branded cardboard box printed 'D750' sits in front of a larger box showing an image of a camera mounted on a gimbal stabilizer; a 'Nikkor Lens 50' box is also visible.
Photo 1: The D750 box is open, showing only printed paper manuals ('D750 User's Manual', French manual) and a shrink-wrapped manual packet; no camera body is visible.
Photo 2: Interior of a box showing items wrapped in bubble wrap; shapes are indistinct, no visible camera body, lens mount, screen, or serial plate.
No photo shows the actual camera body, its screen, lens mount, battery, memory card slot, or serial number.
A gimbal/stabilizer box (zhiyun-style) and a separate 50mm lens box appear in the frame, suggesting a bundle, but only the D750 box text confirms the camera model.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and a seller name overlay are visible on all photos.

claims.evidence: No camera body, serial plate, or country-of-origin marking is visible in any photo; only retail packaging is shown.
No photo of the actual camera body's exterior, LCD, or lens mount to assess cosmetic condition.
No power-on photo, screen display, or shutter count shown; bubble-wrapped contents in photo 2 are not identifiable as a camera.

risks.risk: Box may not actually contain a working Nikon D750 (could be empty, a different item, or a non-functional unit).
risks.proof: A photo of the camera body removed from packaging, powered on, showing the rear screen and Nikon menu.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / condition unverified

risks.risk: No serial number visible, so authenticity and 'American' origin claim cannot be checked.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the serial number plate on the base of the camera, matching the box's serial sticker.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified grey-market/generic used unit

risks.risk: Shutter count unknown, which heavily affects DSLR resale value.
risks.proof: A screen photo or shutter-count app reading showing actuation count.

risks.risk: Listing bundles unrelated boxed items (lens, gimbal) which may not all be included, causing price confusion.
risks.proof: A single photo showing all items laid out together with the camera visibly powered on.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual camera body outside any box, powered on, showing the rear LCD screen.
Close-up of the serial number plate on the camera base.
Photo or screenshot showing the shutter actuation count.
Photo of the lens mount and sensor area for scratches/fungus.
response.reason: The item is identifiable from box text as a Nikon D750 body, but no photo shows the actual camera, so condition and functionality claims are unverifiable and must be priced at worst case (as not working, unverified authenticity).
